More From Mesopotamia
25 Sep 2015: Iraqi crude oil production.Â After OPEC decided in November 2014 to maintain market share rather than protect the oil price, total OPEC output has increased significantly. According to IEA estimates, OPEC production (including NGLs) increased from 36.6 Million barrels per day (Mb/d) to 38.5 Mb/d in recent months.
